citation.text_span: Tranche reference SN-2026-0111
1. Issuer. The Notes are issued by Northbridge Capital Markets (Canada) Inc..
The aggregate Notional Amount is 4,500,000 USD.
The Specified Currency is USD and all payments under the Notes are made in USD.
Trade Date: May 26, 2026.
Issue Date: June 2, 2026.
Maturity Date: June 2, 2028, subject to adjustment in accordance with Condition 9.
The Notes are linked to the worst performing of the S&P 500 Index (Bloomberg: SPX Index) and the S&P/TSX 60 Index (Bloomberg: SPTSX60 Index).
The Initial Level is 100 per cent. of the official closing level of each Underlying on the Trade Date.
Knock-in Event: the Notes are subject to a knock-in barrier observed on the Final Valuation Date only (European observation) at a Knock-in Level of 60 per cent. of the Initial Level.
at a Knock-in Level of 60 per cent. of the Initial Level.
the Notes bear a Coupon of 8.4 per cent. per annum, payable quarterly.

Memory feature: if a Coupon is not paid on a Coupon Payment Date because the Coupon Condition is not satisfied, that Coupon is not lost. It will be paid, together with the Coupon then due, on the first subsequent Coupon Payment Date on which the Coupon Condition is satisfied.
Autocall Observation Dates: May 26, 2027, November 26, 2027.

if on any Autocall Observation Date the closing level of the Underlying is at or above 100 per cent. of the Initial Level, the Notes redeem early at 100% of the Notional Amount plus the Coupon then due.
calculated on the basis of 30/360.
10. Settlement. Cash settlement.
Where any payment date would otherwise fall on a day that is not a Business Day, it shall be adjusted in accordance with the Modified Following Business Day Convention.
